text: 华天科技(002185.SZ)公告称，公司拟通过发行股份及支付现金方式购买华羿微电子100%股份并募集配套资金。根据深交所并购重组审核委员会2026年第12次审议会议公告，该委员会定于2026年8月13日审核本次交易。本次交易尚需深交所审核通过及证监会同意注册后方可实施，存在不确定性。
text_en: Huatian Technology (002185.SZ) announced that the company plans to acquire 100% shares of Huayi Microelectronics through issuance of shares and cash payment, along with raising supporting funds. According to the announcement of the 12th review meeting of the SZSE M&A and Restructuring Review Committee in 2026, the committee is scheduled to review this transaction on August 13, 2026. The transaction is still subject to approval by the SZSE and registration by the CSRC before implementation and remains uncertain.
